name: Gem Hacienda
positioning: A private, whole-home adobe estate in the Taos foothills, rented as a full buyout with a dedicated concierge, run by Drip Castle Estate Collection
best_for: Large groups, family reunions and retreats who want a whole estate to themselves
Skiers and outdoor lovers wanting a private base near Taos Ski Valley

facts.text: Gem Hacienda is an adobe-style estate on eight private acres in the foothills of the Sangre de Cristo Mountains.
The estate is just minutes from downtown Taos and the Taos Pueblo, a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
Every bedroom has a private ensuite bathroom, and the estate accommodates up to 30 guests.
Expansive gathering rooms have soaring wood-beamed ceilings.
Select bedrooms open onto private patios.
Outdoor lounge spaces include a hot tub, fire pit and bocce court.
The estate has a professional chef's kitchen and a formal dining room.
The concierge can book on-site wellness experiences, from massage therapists to yoga instructors.
Add-on experiences include art classes and guided gallery tours.
Taos Plaza is 5 minutes away and Taos Ski Valley is within a 30-minute drive.
The estate has a ski storage rack, and Molton Brown bathroom amenities are included.
Small to medium dogs are welcome with prior approval.

highlights.text: A stay is a full buyout of the property, giving guests exclusive access to the whole estate.
Gem Hacienda is a traditional adobe home set on eight private acres with sweeping mountain views.
Bedrooms have in-room gas kiva fireplaces, and the estate has indoor and outdoor fireplaces.
The estate has a private adobe horno for outdoor cooking experiences.
Every stay includes a dedicated, complimentary concierge who arranges chefs, activities and wellness sessions before arrival.

considerations.text: This is a private whole-home rental booked as a full buyout, not a hotel; housekeeping is offered as an add-on service.
Most guests stay for a week or more, and check-in and check-out times are confirmed with the concierge before arrival.
WhataHotel notes limited on-site dining options.
